card.name: Word just before "every" in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The word right before "every" in a dosing schedule, such as "once", "administered", "mg" or "injection", when an interval like "every 4 weeks" comes next.

modes.label: Frequency word
modes.description: "once" or "one dose" just before "every N weeks".
modes.example: 210 mg administered subcutaneously<< once>> every 4 weeks.

modes.label: Dose or route word
modes.description: A dose unit, verb or route word right before "every" and an interval.
modes.example: Doses of 20 mg may be<< administered>> every 4 hours.

card.writes: It boosts "each" and lowers "every", so it steers the model away from predicting "every".
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "every" in a dosing schedule, like "once" in "once every 4 weeks".
